Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all we have from the lopsided affair! Australia Women have sealed a spot in the semi-final, while Barbados Women still have a chance to go through, but it's not going to be an easy task for them. It will be England Women up against South Africa Women in the next encounter of the Women's T20 in the Commonwealth Games 2022. That game will be played on Tuesday, 2nd August. The action is set to get underway at 3.30 pm IST (10.00 am GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. Do join us then. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Earlier in the game, Meg Lanning elected to bowl first and the bowlers absolutely bamboozled the batting line-up of Barbados Women. They bundled their opposition out for just 64 runs, with Alana King grabbing four wickets and Tahlia McGrath picking three. In the end, they breezed past and got over the line within 9 overs and with 9 wickets in hand.

It was all too easy for Australia Women! They lost an early wicket by losing Beth Mooney for just two runs. But losing one wicket was never going to put Australia Women under pressure. They had many wickets in hand with fewer runs to chase. Meg Lanning walked in to bat and started firing from the word go. Alyssa Healy on the other hand took her time to settle in but once she was set, there was no stopping her. The duo stitched an unbeaten partnership of 63 runs and took Australia Women home comfortably. Time and again they have proved why they are the World Champions, and this game was just another instance of that.

Barbados Women got off to a perfect start while coming to bowl. Shanika Bruce in her first over sent back Beth Mooney for a timid score. However, they needed way more wickets to put  Australia Women under pressure which they failed to do so. They started leaking runs post that and were handed a crushing defeat in the end. A tough day in the office for Barbados Women! They will need to reflect on their performance and come back stronger if they want to qualify for the semi-final.

A convincing victory for Australia Women! Well, chasing a target of 65 was always going to be a walk in the park for the World Champions! With this win, they have grabbed a total of 4 points and have progressed to the semi-final of this exuberant tournament. While Barbados Women have a lot to ponder about for their next game.

FOUR! Australia Women get there in fine fashion!  Shakera Selman serves this short and angles this into the batter. Meg Lanning rocks back and pulls this towards deep backward point for four runs! Australia Women confirm their spot in the semi-finals! This has been an easy 9-wicket victory!
Shakera Selman serves this wide down leg side, Alyssa Healy looks to pull this and misses. The keeper can not collect and they take a extra wide run. Scores are level now.
Tosses it up, slower through the air, around middle. Meg Lanning blocks it out. The ball was rolling away towards the stumps, but Meg Lanning does well to keep it away!
Tosses it up, full and around off. Alyssa Healy drills it towards long off and takes a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Fuller again, around off. Alyssa Healy dances down the pitch and lifts this one over cover for a boundary. Australia Women are 4 away!
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller ball, tosses this one up, around middle. Alyssa Healy advances down the pitch and smashes it over mid on for a boundary. Australia Women need only 8 more now!
Another half-tracker, turning away, outside off. Meg Lanning slaps this one through cover. Only a single!
Keila Elliott begins with a shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Drifting in, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy stays in her crease and tucks it towards square leg for a single. She retains the strike!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Lovely shot! A fuller one again, around off. Alyssa Healy gets low and reverse-sweeps this one towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! First boundary for Alyssa Healy! Another loopy ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy steps down the pitch and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Shorter this time, spinning away, outside off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Tosses this one up, very full and around off. Alyssa Healy drives it towards cover.
A fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy reverse-sweeps it along the ground towards Deandra Dottin at first slip.
FOUR! Deandra Dottin serves a wide yorker. Meg Lanning reaches for it and gets this past backward point for a boundary! 25 runs of the over and Australia Women just need 23 more runs to win!
WIDE! This is short and angling down leg, Meg Lanning looks to pull this one as well and misses. Called wide this time.

NO BALL AND SIX! Deandra Dottin is going for plenty here! Meg Lanning over compensates and bowls an above waist full toss, Meg Lanning pulls this ball over deep backward square leg for a biggie! This one has flown far into the crowd and Australia Women get a Free Hit.
Six! Meg Lanning gets this one over the fence! Deandra Dottin serves this one short and angled into the batter. Meg Lanning pulls and gets a top edge that flies over deep sqaure leg for a maximum!
Full and outside off, Meg Lanning goes for the drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes full and in line with the stumps, Meg Lanning flicks this to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Short and angling down leg, Meg Lanning looks to pull and misses. This seems to be wide down leg but is not given.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Deandra Dottin is a shade unlucky and Meg Lanning gets four! This is full and outside off, Meg Lanning goes for the drive and gets an outside edge fine towards the third man fence for a boundary! Deandra Dottin has over-stepped and this will be a Free Hit.
Deandra Dottin begins with a full delivery wide outside off, Meg Lanning taps this towards point.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy rocks back and pushes it towards cover. A maiden from Hayley Matthews!
Make that five! Fuller this time, around off. Alyssa Healy strides forward and blocks this one.
Spinning in, shorter ball, around off. Alyssa Healy pushes it towards cover. 4 dots in a row now!
Tosses this up, full, around off. Alyssa Healy leans forward and defends it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it towards the fielder at cover.
Hayley Matthews begins with a fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy blocks it out.
Another full toss, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it towards cover.
This one tails back in, on a length, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy turns away towards square leg and takes a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Alyssa Healy pushes it back to the bowler.
Another full toss, around middle. Meg Lanning pulls it towards square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to her left, slides, and makes a goo stop. Single again!
Shorter ball, outside off. Meg Lanning stays in her crease and plays it towards mid off.
A full toss now, on the pads. Alyssa Healy swipes this one towards square leg. Only a single.
Shamilia Connell serves it on a length now, outside off. Meg Lanning drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Meg Lanning blocks it off the back foot towards cover-point.
FOUR! Second boundary for Meg Lanning! Width on offer now, a length ball. Meg Lanning stays in her crease and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Alyssa Healy stays in her crease and taps it toward cover. A single this time!
Pitches this one up again, around off. Alyssa Healy shows the full face of the bat and pushes it towards the fielder at mid off.
Fuller ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy opens the face of her bat and pushes it towards cover-point.
FOUR! Meg Lanning gets off the mark in style! A shorter ball, around middle. Meg Lanning swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. First boundary of the chase!
A low full toss, around off. Meg Lanning drives this one and finds the fielder at cover.
Swinging in, on a length, around middle and leg. Meg Lanning taps it towards square leg.
Fuller one, around off. Meg Lanning drives it towards mid off.
The skipper, Meg Lanning walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! Beth Mooney tries to be aggressive but she perishes! Shanika Bruce gets her first wicket in international cricket! A fuller ball, wide of off. Beth Mooney advances down the pitch and tries to slash this away but she fails to reach the ball. Kycia Knight grabs the ball and whips the bails off. Beth Mooney walks back! Just the start Barbados Women needed!
Commentary.Howout: st Kycia Knight b Shanika Bruce

Commentary.Commentary: Shanika Bruce begins with a fuller ball, around off. Beth Mooney blocks it out.
Shanika Bruce comes into the attack from the other end.
Fuller ball, around middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it back to the bowler.
A length ball, around the off pole. Beth Mooney stays in her crease and gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Beth Mooney leans forward and blocks it out.
Swing and a miss! Full and outside off, at around 107 clicks. Beth Mooney looks to drive this one but she misses.
TWO WIDES! A fuller ball, down the leg side. Alyssa Healy misses her flick. The keeper fails to grab the ball as well. Another run taken!
Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Beth Mooney pushes it towards cover for a single. Beth Mooney is off the mark straightaway!
A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Alyssa Healy tucks it towards square leg and takes a single. Australia Women and Alyssa Healy are underway!
